audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Gnar/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Gnar, giving Gnar the 2-item stage. Packet says Gnar,Gnar,Skill,Skill,Skill,Skill,Volibear and the content prose agrees with the packet.
audit.why: whys[1] describes a free level-2 chunk Voli cannot answer before W is stacked — a Gnar stage. whys[6] and late both say he out-scales you at two items and you should stop duelling him; marking that stage Gnar contradicts the page's own body text.
audit.corrected: Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Volibear, proposed as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer spike language was 'Stridebreaker is your spike' with no Volibear timings.
audit.why: His spikes are Thundering Smash online (12s at rank 1, only falling to 10s), Stormbringer at 6 (160s at rank 1 — a very long cooldown you can play around) and his first tank item, when Frenzied Maul's heal starts out-grinding chip.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into the cooldown block and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never states that Thundering Smash is an auto-attack reset whose stun lands on the ATTACK, not the cast, and never states that Frenzied Maul applies on-hit effects.
audit.why: Both flagged missing interactions. The reset means the visual cue to back off is the wind-up, not the ability animation — players who react to the cast are already stunned. And because Maul applies on-hit and his passive stacks attack speed, reading the trade off armour alone under-counts his damage. Sky Splitter also shields him only if he stands in his own blast, which is a bait tell.
audit.corrected: Stated the auto reset and its tell, Maul's on-hit/attack-speed scaling and 5s cooldown, Sky Splitter's self-shield condition, and Stormbringer's 160s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer is written in FIRST person ('I', 'me', 'my') — whys[1..6], early, mid and late all break the user's second-person voice.
audit.why: Every other matchup on the site addresses the reader as 'you'. This page reads as someone else's diary and is the only one in the champion that does.
audit.corrected: All first-person pronouns converted to second person, same length band, no content change.

notes: This matchup's content layer was the only one written in first person — converted whys[1..6], early, mid and late to second person without changing the analysis. Both missing interactions now reach the page: Thundering Smash's auto reset (the stun lands on the ATTACK, so the wind-up is the tell) and Frenzied Maul applying on-hit, which is why reading the trade off armour alone under-counts him. Also corrected the framing on Stormbringer: at 160s at rank 1 it is one of the longest ultimate cooldowns in the game, which makes baiting it a real lane plan rather than something to merely 'respect'.
